text:
maria: FYI customer reported timeouts hitting /v1/generate around 15:45 UTC. Trace ID 7e1b4a2d. Kibana trace shows request routed to gpu-pool-3 host gpu-12 but logs missing after x-request-id. Anyone seen this pattern?

sam: ok grabbing trace 7e1b4a2d. If logs missing maybe Loki shard index gap. Trying a broad Loki query: ` {job="inference"} |= "7e1b4a2d" ` to start.

alex: you might need trace-id vs correlation-id mismatch, try searching for `trace:7e1b4a2d` and also `x-correlation-id:7e1b4a2d` in Kibana. Also check `host=gpu-12` logs.

sam: ran Loki query, only prefix logs found during scheduling, then silence. Example query I used: `loki> {job="inference"} |~ "7e1b4a2d|gpu-12|x-request-id" | line_format "{{.message}}"` — returned nothing after 15:45:12.

natalie: Prometheus shows GPU host `gpu-12` had a short node-exporter scrape gap at 15:45:10. Grafana panel `node-exporter:scrape_errors:count` spiked then resolved. Possible transient network partition to that rack. :eyes: 

maria: if host lost network to Loki, logs won't arrive. But request traces should still be in Tempo/Jaeger — can someone check traces?

alex: checked Tempo, span exists up to runtime.start then no `runtime.request_end` span. That's consistent with the process getting SIGKILL or kernel OOM. Check dmesg on gpu-12.

sam: I ssh'd into gpu-12 via bastion, dmesg shows oom_killer invoked at 15:45:11 killing process `inference-worker` pid 4321. Logs rotated mid-run, so the request got killed. We should correlate with Pod evictions.

natalie: Kubernetes events show eviction for node gpu-12: `OutOfmemory` and kubelet drained pods. Looks like node had memory pressure from nightly watchdog job hitting a mem leak.

maria: thanks — next steps: 1) add a Loki write-fallback so nodes buffer logs locally for short partitions; 2) tune Prometheus alert to reduce noise (increase `for` from 1m to 3m for `node_scrape_error`); 3) add SLO alert: if `trace_end` missing for >5m trigger a page.

sam: wrote quick Loki backfill from node local file: `kubectl cp gpu-12:/var/log/inference/worker.log - | gzip -` and pushed to GCS. Backfill link: https://gcs.company/reports/trace-7e1b4a2d.gz

alertmanager: Pager suppressed (silenced) for node-exporter:gpu-12 by @maria for 15m while we investigate.

alex: follow-up: that watchdog job runs nightly; I'll move it to a low-memory pool or add `oom_score_adj` protection for inference workers.

maria: created ticket INF-4721 with root cause, mitigation plan, and action owners. Assigning oncall for postmortem.

sam: quick note — we should also add a Loki query helper snippet to our runbook: `# find logs by trace/corr id
{job="inference"} |= "7e1b4a2d" or {job="inference"} |= "x-correlation-id=7e1b4a2d"`

natalie: updated Grafana alert rule draft in repo: `alerts/node_scrape_error.yaml` with `for: 3m` and added silence window for known maintenance.

maria: good. we can close this Slack thread when INF-4721 has the deployment plan. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
